package.description: A native Windows 11 desktop bar inspired by Linux desktop bars.

en-US.description: A native Windows 11 desktop bar inspired by Linux desktop bars.
en-US.longDescription: BuffMyBar is a native Windows 11 desktop bar (WPF / .NET 8) inspired by the flexibility of Linux bars like Waybar and Polybar. Multi-monitor, follows the Windows theme, with clock, weather, media, network, Bluetooth, battery, volume, an audio visualizer and OBS integration.
en-US.name: BuffMyBar
